entities.name: Query protein dITP/XTP hydrolase
observations: 201-aa query is 57.5% identical over 95% coverage to reviewed Lactiplantibacillus plantarum dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase Q88V20 (E=1.52e-73).
Close homolog annotations identify hydrolysis of noncanonical purine triphosphates XTP, dITP and ITP to monophosphate products; exact specificity in query is inferred, not experimentally established.

entities.name: Purine triphosphate catabolism
observations: Reviewed close homologs are annotated for purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolism (GO:0009146), including cleanup of noncanonical XTP, dITP and ITP nucleotides.
